groupings.title: Video to knowledge base
groupings.description: Paste a YouTube link or drop in an MP4 and get back a markdown note you can actually trust — every claim deep-linked to the second it was said, the moments that only make sense on screen embedded as screenshots.

groupings.title: Video extraction primitives
groupings.description: The two halves of the pipeline, usable on their own: the words, with a quality gate that tells you when a transcript is lying to you, and the pixels, with scene detection tuned to the video in front of it rather than to a number from a blog post.
